scope: English question text only under the frozen question-only prompt
interpretation_boundary: These deterministic features are surface/factual proxies, not direct measurements of memorization or named-entity representations.

features.has_capitalized_span: At least one capitalized lexical span after filtering fixed sentence-initial/function-word exclusions.
features.has_date_word: A frozen English month, weekday, or calendar-unit word.
features.has_person_cue: A frozen person/factual-agent cue such as who, author, invented, discovered, founded, or born.
features.has_location_cue: A frozen location cue such as where, capital, country, city, located, or continent.
features.has_temporal_cue: A frozen temporal cue such as when, year, date, century, era, or period.
features.has_factual_association_cue: A frozen phrase such as known for, author of, invented, discovered, capital of, symbol for, or located in.
features.has_entity_attribute_proxy: A capitalized span co-occurs with a frozen attribute/relation cue; this is explicitly a proxy and not NER.
